title: How Netflix’s Messy Transition Will Rock Hollywood: Looking at You, NBCU
content:
The upheaval of Peter Rice’s appointment and Bela Bajaria’s ouster as chief content officer sets off speculation about the streaming giant’s next moves

It started with a dinner.

Peter Riceand Ynon Kreiz met for a meal in late September, days before Kreiz surprised the industry by jumping from the CEO job at Mattel to become co-chief executive of Skydance with David Ellison.

The report of the Kreiz-Rice meeting came in the New York Post’s Page Six after Kreiz’s role at Skydance was announced. That set off speculation that he was recruiting Rice for a big role at the enlarged studio. It turns out Kreiz had been trying to persuade Rice to take a board seat at Barbie’s house.

Rice, however, was not destined to advise on matters of Uno and Matchbox cars. The former Fox Searchlight and Fox Networks Group chief — who went to Disney in 2019 as its top TV executive only to be unceremoniously axed during the Chapek regime — has vaulted back to one of the town’s most powerful posts: chief content officer ofNetflix.

Media coverage of Kreiz’s courtship of Rice is one of the spurs that pushed Netflix to make the move on a hire that will have ripple effects across its expansive film and TV operations. The ouster ofBela Bajariafrom the role that Rice now occupies was messy, and angered many inside and outside of Netflix.

“We don’t live in Hollywood right now. We live in Silicon Valley,” said a prominent agent, citing the general mood of the creative community. The brusque treatment of an executive of Bajaria’s stature is a sign that no one is safe from scrutiny, and no one should ever count on making a graceful exit.

“It feels like more of a tech approach than a studio approach to letting someone go. It’s shameful, it sucks and it adds to the feeling that we’re all working by Silicon Valley rules,” the agent said.

The source noted the irony of Bajaria getting the ax just two weeks after the executive that she replaced at Netflix — Cindy Holland — was also hastily ousted from her new role at Skydance. Holland’s role was sacrificed to make room for Casey Bloys, the HBO chief who is taking over all streaming now that the Warner Bros. Discovery merger is completed.

The bombshell executive upheaval at Netflix, coupled with signals that insiders are reading from the layoffs that Netflix implemented this week, has set off renewed speculation about the streaming giant getting back in the hunt for a major studio or some other significant content assets. NBCUniversal is a logical target, given that the company will be spun out from Comcast next year and thus would make for a much smaller and more manageable acquisition than the entirety of Comcast.

The switch to Rice also raises questions about whether Netflix will remain as aggressive in its local-language content strategy as it had been under Bajaria. Rice’s reference in his first memo to Netflix staffers to the need to deliver more buzzy hits for the “UCAN” market (Netflix’s wonky term for the United States and Canada) did not go unnoticed.

Bajaria, according to multiple sources, learned the harsh reality of her fate on Wednesday evening when she cornered Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos before the screening at a private residence in L.A. for the Season 3 premiere of comedy “Nobody Wants This.” (Notably, neither Sarandos nor Bajaria are seen in any of the publicity photos that have been shared from the event.)

At the event, Bajaria asked Sarandos point-blank whether there was truth to the rumors gaining stream — and Sarandos, who it’s believed was originally going to break the news on Monday, told her right at that moment.

Rumors about Bajaria’s fate have swirled in recent months. As the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger saga soldiered on, there was much speculation about HBO chief Bloys jumping ship for a big role at Netflix or to launch a well-funded prestige label for the streamer. But once Bloys was confirmed as the new top boss of streaming for Skydance, the Bajaria speculation cooled off. On Monday, Bajaria was on stage at the Mipcom content conference in Cannes, where she accepted the Vanguard Award for contributions to the global marketplace as bestowed byVarietyand Mipcom.

But even as top European content industry insiders gathered to hear Bajaria speak, chatter about her future fired back up in Hollywood this week. It turned out to be a perfect storm of events, with Netflix bracing for its largest-ever layoffs and its third-quarter earnings report coming on Oct. 20. The layoffs, amounting to 6% of the company’s workforce, or about 1,000 positions, were implemented Tuesday and Wednesday. That meant Netflix staffers were already on edge when the shock of the Rice news hit just after lunchtime in L.A. on Thursday.

Meanwhile, as recently as two weeks ago Rice was telling friends that he had no interest in becoming an executive again — which is a sign that Sarandos acted fast as soon as he learned Rice was available.

Bajaria is understood to have received an outpouring of support from her wide network of contacts in the creative community, at home and abroad. Multiple sources say the executive has been telling friends outright that she is shell-shocked, in keeping with her reputation for candor. Bajaria declined to comment.

The microscope now turns to Bajaria’s two top vertical lieutenants — Dan Lin in film, and Jinny Howe in original TV series.

Lin has been a steady hand in Netflix’s film operations for two-and-a-half years, ushered in to stop the lavish spending of the streamer’s formative Scott Stuber era. Slashing budgets carries an emotional price, though, and Lin has been forced to ensure talent delivers quality product without a widely perceived blank check signed by Sarandos.

In addition to making cheaper movies, Lin also backed some high-profile acquisitions (“Emilia Pérez” and Netflix’s current best-hope Oscar contender “La Bola Negra”). Yet, numerous reports have suggested that Lin will exit the company as Rice comes into power. It couldn’t be a more sensitive time, as Netflix will launch Greta Gerwig’s anticipated “Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew” with a full theatrical release in February. As Bajaria got the boot, the rumor mill instantly offered forth Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy — the ousted Warner Bros. Pictures chiefs — as potential replacements (which actually started a month ago, as Paramount and WBD finally found a path to combine).

According to insiders, with Rice likely to kick off his tenure by focusing on the film side of things, U.S. and Canada scripted head Howe appears to be safe in her role. With whispers in Hollywood that Netflix has struggled recently to produce another megahit in the vein of “Stranger Things” or “Bridgerton,” Howe, who took over in August 2025, has a hefty slate on her plate and is just starting to see some of her own development come to fruition.

That includes Meryl Streep in “The Corrections,” Adam Driver and Michael Fassbender in “Rabbit, Rabbit,” Martin Scorsese’s “The Roman” and the live-action/CGI “Scooby-Doo: Origins.”

“They want her to stay,” said one source. “If she left, that’d be a disaster for them.”

Meanwhile, given Rice’s experience, some also wondered whether Sarandos just hired someone who could ultimately be a candidate to replace him — should the stock continue to suffer and the company see a need to make more changes.

The week has indeed offered more drama than anything Netflix will put on its service this year.
title_zh: Netflix的混亂轉型將如何震撼好萊塢：我們在看著你，NBCU(NBCUniversal)
content_zh:
彼得·賴斯(Peter Rice)的任命和貝拉·巴賈里亞(Bela Bajaria)作為首席內容官的罷免引發了對這家串流巨頭下一步動作的猜測。

一切始於一頓晚餐。

彼得·賴斯(Peter Rice)和伊農·克雷茲(Ynon Kreiz)在九月底會面，幾天後，克雷茲驚訝業界，從美泰兒(Mattel)的首席執行官職位跳槽，成為斯凱達克斯(Skydance)的聯合首席執行官，與大衛·艾利森(David Ellison)共事。

克雷茲與賴斯會面的報導出現在《紐約郵報》(New York Post)的第六頁，隨著克雷茲在斯凱達克斯的角色被宣布，這引發了他在擴大的工作室中招聘賴斯的猜測。結果顯示，克雷茲一直在試圖說服賴斯擔任芭比(Barbie)的董事會成員。

然而，賴斯並不打算就烏諾(Uno)和火柴盒車(Matchbox cars)的事務提供建議。這位前福斯搜尋光(Fox Searchlight)和福斯網絡集團(Fox Networks Group)的首席，於2019年進入迪士尼(Disney)擔任首席電視高管，卻在查佩克(Chapek)政權期間被無情地解雇，現在已經重返這個城市最有權力的職位之一：奈飛(Netflix)的首席內容官。

媒體對克雷茲對賴斯的追求的報導，是促使奈飛做出這一人事變動的催化劑，這將對其廣泛的電影和電視業務產生連鎖反應。巴賈里亞的罷免過程混亂，令奈飛內外的許多人感到憤怒。

“一位知名經紀人表示：「我們現在不生活在好萊塢。我們生活在矽谷。」他引用了創意社群的一般情緒。對於巴賈里亞這樣的高管的粗暴對待，顯示出沒有人能夠逃脫審視，沒有人應該指望能夠優雅地退出。

“這感覺更像是一種科技公司而非工作室的解雇方式。這是可恥的，這很糟糕，這增強了我們都在遵循矽谷規則工作的感覺，”這位經紀人說。

消息來源指出，巴賈里亞在被解雇的兩週後，她在奈飛的接任者辛迪·霍蘭(Cindy Holland)也匆忙被罷免，這一點具有諷刺意味。霍蘭的角色被犧牲，以便為HBO首席凱西·布洛伊斯(Kasey Bloys)騰出空間，後者在華納兄弟探索(Warner Bros. Discovery)合併完成後，將接管所有串流業務。

奈飛的高管震盪，加上內部人士對本週奈飛實施的裁員所發出的信號，再次引發了對這家串流巨頭重新尋找大型工作室或其他重要內容資產的猜測。考慮到NBC環球(NBCUniversal)將於明年從康卡斯特(Comcast)分拆出來，這家公司成為一個合乎邏輯的目標，因此將比整個康卡斯特的收購更小且更易於管理。

轉換至萊斯(Rice)的決定也引發了人們對於Netflix在本地語言內容策略上是否會像在巴哈里亞(Bajaria)任內那樣積極的質疑。萊斯在給Netflix員工的第一封備忘錄中提到需要為“UCAN”市場（Netflix對美國和加拿大的獨特稱呼）提供更多引人注目的熱門作品，這一點並未被忽視。

根據多個消息來源，巴哈里亞在週三晚上於洛杉磯一處私人住宅舉行的喜劇《沒人想要這個》(Nobody Wants This) 第三季首映會前，與Netflix聯合首席執行官泰德·薩蘭多斯(Ted Sarandos)面對面時，得知了她命運的殘酷現實。（值得注意的是，薩蘭多斯和巴哈里亞都未出現在活動的任何宣傳照片中。）

在活動中，巴哈里亞直截了當地詢問薩蘭多斯，關於日益增長的傳聞是否有真實性，而薩蘭多斯據信原本計劃在週一宣布這一消息，卻在那一刻告訴了她。

關於巴哈里亞命運的傳聞在最近幾個月中不斷流傳。隨著派拉蒙與華納兄弟探索的合併故事持續發展，外界對HBO首席執行官布洛伊斯(Bloys)跳槽至Netflix或為該串流平台創建一個資金充足的高端品牌的猜測甚囂塵上。但當布洛伊斯被確認為Skydance串流業務的新負責人後，巴哈里亞的猜測便冷卻下來。週一，巴哈里亞在戛納的Mipcom內容大會上登台，接受了由《綜藝》(Variety)和Mipcom頒發的全球市場貢獻先鋒獎(Vanguard Award)。

然而，即使在歐洲內容產業的高層人士聚集在一起聆聽巴哈里亞的演講時，關於她未來的討論本週在好萊塢再次升溫。這成為了一場完美的風暴，Netflix正準備進行有史以來最大規模的裁員，並且第三季度的財報將於10月20日公布。這次裁員涉及公司6%的員工，約1,000個職位，於週二和週三實施。這意味著當萊斯的消息在週四洛杉磯午餐後傳出時，Netflix的員工已經感到緊張不安。

同時，就在兩週前，萊斯還告訴朋友他對再次成為高管沒有興趣——這表明薩蘭多斯在得知萊斯可用後迅速採取了行動。

據了解，巴哈里亞在國內外的創意社群中獲得了廣泛的支持。多個消息來源表示，這位高管已經直言不諱地告訴朋友們她感到震驚，這與她直率的聲譽相符。巴哈里亞拒絕評論。

現在的焦點轉向巴哈里亞的兩位主要副手——電影部的丹·林(Dan Lin)和原創電視劇部的金妮·豪(Jinny Howe)。

林(Lin)在Netflix的電影業務中已經穩定工作了兩年半，受邀進入以停止這個串流平台在斯科特·斯圖伯(Scott Stuber)時期的奢華開支。然而，削減預算帶來的情感代價不容小覷，林必須確保人才能在沒有薩蘭多斯(Sarandos)簽署的廣泛認可的空白支票的情況下交付高品質的產品。

除了製作更便宜的電影，林還支持了一些高調的收購（如《艾米莉亞·佩雷斯(Emilia Pérez)》以及Netflix目前最有希望的奧斯卡競爭者《黑球(La Bola Negra)》）。然而，多個報導指出，隨著萊斯(Rice)的上任，林將會離開公司。這正是一個敏感的時刻，因為Netflix將在二月份推出格蕾塔·葛韋格(Greta Gerwig)備受期待的《納尼亞：魔法師的侄子(Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew)》，並進行全面的院線發行。隨著巴哈里亞(Bajaria)被解雇，傳聞立刻將被罷免的華納兄弟影業(Warner Bros. Pictures)首席執行官邁克爾·德盧卡(Michael De Luca)和帕梅拉·阿布迪(Pamela Abdy)視為潛在的接替人選（這其實在一個月前就已經開始，因為派拉蒙(Paramount)和WBD終於找到合併的途徑）。

根據內部人士的消息，隨著萊斯可能會專注於電影業務開始他的任期，美國和加拿大劇本部門負責人豪(Hoe)似乎在她的角色中是安全的。隨著好萊塢傳出Netflix最近在製作類似《怪奇物語(Stranger Things)》或《布里奇頓(Bridgerton)》的超級熱門作品方面遇到困難，豪在2025年八月接任後，手上有一份繁重的工作計劃，並且剛開始看到她的一些開發項目開始結出成果。

這包括梅莉爾·史翠普(Meryl Streep)主演的《修正案(The Corrections)》，亞當·德賴弗(Adam Driver)和邁克爾·法斯賓德(Michael Fassbender)主演的《兔子，兔子(Rabbit, Rabbit)》，馬丁·斯科塞斯(Martin Scorsese)的《羅馬(The Roman)》以及真人版/CGI的《史酷比：起源(Scooby-Doo: Origins)》。

“一個消息來源說：‘他們希望她留下。如果她離開，對他們來說將是災難。’”

同時，考慮到萊斯的經驗，有人也懷疑薩蘭多斯是否只是雇用了一個最終可能成為接替他候選人的人——如果股票持續下滑，公司看到需要進行更多變革的話。

這一周確實提供了比Netflix今年將在其服務上推出的任何內容更多的戲劇性。
